entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-gate
entry.summary: Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add". Exact install spec: github:863683348/dsh-plugin-gate. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
